question: According to Census 2011 of India, which Indian state has the highest urban population percentage?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census 2011 of India, **Goa** has the highest urban population percentage among Indian states, at **62.17%**.
 
• The state is highly urbanized due to its tourism-driven economy and well-developed infrastructure.
 
• Other states with high urban population percentages include Tamil Nadu (48.45%) and Kerala (47.72%), but they fall behind Goa.
 
• The urbanization in Goa is influenced by its small geographical size and high density of urban settlements, including Panaji and Margao.
 
• Goa's urbanization is supported by its high literacy rate and modern lifestyle, attracting both domestic and international tourists.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urbanization:**

 
 
• Urbanization refers to the increasing population concentration in urban areas compared to rural areas.
 
• It is often driven by factors such as industrialization, better job opportunities, and improved living standards.
 
 
 
• **Census 2011:**
 
 
• The Census of India 2011 is the 15th national census since 1872.
 
• It provides detailed data on population, literacy, urbanization, and various socio-economic indicators.
 
 
 
• **Urban Population in India:**
 
 
• The overall urban population in India as per the 2011 Census is around **31.16%**.
 
• States with high urbanization levels often have better infrastructure, industrial growth, and employment opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Factors Contributing to Goa's Urbanization:**
 
 
• Tourism: Goa's thriving tourism industry contributes significantly to urban development.
 
• Infrastructure: The state has well-developed roads, ports, and other facilities supporting urban growth.
 
• Economic Opportunities: High employment in services, especially tourism and hospitality, attracts people to urban centers.
